en.title: Handwoven wool rug, Zapotec fret pattern
en.description: Rug woven on a pedal loom with the Mitla fret pattern in red and indigo. Flat weave, finished with knotted fringe on both ends.
en.materials: 100% sheep's wool, hand-spun; dyed with cochineal and indigo
en.provenance: Woven by Lucía Hernández in Teotitlán del Valle, Oaxaca, where her family has woven for four generations. One rug takes about three weeks.

native.title: Tapete de lana tejido a mano, grecas zapotecas
native.description: Tapete tejido en telar de pedal con grecas de Mitla en rojo e índigo. Tejido plano, con flecos anudados en ambos extremos.
native.materials: 100% lana de borrego hilada a mano; teñida con grana cochinilla e índigo
native.provenance: Lo tejió Lucía Hernández en Teotitlán del Valle, Oaxaca, donde su familia teje desde hace cuatro generaciones. Un tapete lleva unas tres semanas.

en.title: Buri palm market basket with handles
en.description: Sturdy round basket with two braided handles, good for market trips or storing fruit.
en.care: Wipe with a dry cloth. Keep away from standing water; let it air dry if it gets wet.
en.provenance: Made by Rosa Villanueva in Manila using a weaving pattern from Bohol.

native.title: Bayong na buri na may hawakan
native.description: Matibay na bilog na bayong na may dalawang tinirintas na hawakan, bagay sa pamamalengke o lalagyan ng prutas.
native.materials: Dahon ng buri, gilid na yantok
native.care: Punasan ng tuyong tela. Ilayo sa nakatigil na tubig; patuyuin sa hangin kapag nabasa.
native.provenance: Gawa ni Rosa Villanueva sa Maynila gamit ang disenyong mula sa Bohol.
